messages.author: 749d7267acb45608
messages.subject: Software warning - Error
parts:
Dear list,

I frequently get from my projects a warning message when I try to open =
them. The bad thing is, once this warning comes up, I usually have to do =
it all again, once I can not recover my project.

My operating system is Mac, although I run Distance software using =
Virtual Box, which is a cross-platform virtualization application, as a =

lot of you might konw.

This is the message I get:

The following internal error has occurred in Distance

Unexpected error in Distance Database Engine.
Source: D6DbEng.ProjectDatabase.OpenJetDatabase
internal Error number: 3197

Internal Error description: "The Microsoft Jet database engine stopped =
the process because you and a another user are attempting to change the =

same data at the same time."

(Error raised from: Distance.ClsProject.OpenProjectDatabase)
(Error source: D6DbEng.ProjectDatabase.OpenJetDatabase)
(Error number: -2147211505)
If you suspect this error is caused by a bug in the program, please note =

down all the above information and contact the program authors.

Press Ok and Distance will try to recover from the error.
Press Help for more information about internal erros in Distance.

Is there anything to do?

Carlos Benfica.

-------------------------------------
Carlos Eduardo Benfica
31 - 2514.3303 / 9677.0003
-------------------------------------

messages.subject: Re: Software warning - Error
parts:
Carlos, List,

I've not seen that one before, which makes me think it's an operating system +
emulator issue. If anyone else has encountered this error, on any operating
system, please contact me (off the list) giving:
- operating system
- virtualization software (if OS not Windows)
- hardware

Thanks! - Len Thomas
